## Endpoints

### Auth Flow (2)
- `GET /api-yoa/tags/translated/{translatedToken}/en/` — Get translated tags in English for authorization.
- `GET /api/v1/configs/eval-with-context/{eval-with-contextToken}` — Evaluate configurations with context for authorization.

### Data Read (6)
- `GET /api-yoa/availability/dates` — Check available dates for bookings.
- `GET /api-yoa/availability/ng/widget/range` — Get availability range for the new widget.
- `GET /api-yoa/dining/{diningId}` — Retrieve details for a specific dining experience.
- `GET /api-yoa/languagestrings/gramercytavern/all` — Get all language strings for Gramercy Tavern.
- `GET /api-yoa/upgrades/widget` — Get upgrade widget details for display.
- `GET /discovery/v1/apis/plus/v1/rest` — Discover Google Plus API endpoints.

```typescript
  try {

    console.log("Available Dates:", availableDates);
    return availableDates;
  } catch (error) {
    console.error("Error checking availability:", error);
    return null;
  }
}
```

## About This Skill

This skill provides access to Sevenrooms's internal API — the hidden endpoints that power their web/mobile app.
These are NOT official public APIs. They were captured by observing network traffic while using the site.

**Important:**

- Internal APIs can change without notice — endpoints may break
- Rate limits are unknown — be conservative with request frequency

## When to Use This Skill

Use this skill when you need to:
- Access Sevenrooms data without official API access
- Automate actions on www.sevenrooms.com (faster than browser automation)
